title: Institutes of the Christian Religion
author: John Calvin
edition: Final 1559 Latin in the Beveridge English translation
summary: John Calvin's magnum opus of Reformed systematic theology — four books on the knowledge of God the Creator, God the Redeemer, the mode of obtaining the grace of Christ, and the holy catholic church.

books.title: Of the Knowledge of God the Creator
books.summary: Eighteen chapters on natural knowledge of God, the necessity of Scripture, the unity of the divine essence in three Persons, the creation, providence, and the state of man as created.

Use to Be Made of the Doctrine of Providence
The Instrumentality of the Wicked Employed by God, While He Continues Free From Every Taint

books.title: Of the Knowledge of God the Redeemer in Christ
books.summary: Seventeen chapters on the fall and original sin, the bondage of the will, the necessity of redemption in Christ, the law, the unity of the testaments, and the person and office of the Mediator.

books.title: Of the Mode of Obtaining the Grace of Christ
books.summary: Twenty-five chapters on faith, repentance, the Christian life, self-denial, the cross, the future life, justification, Christian liberty, prayer, election and reprobation, and the resurrection.

books.summary: Twenty chapters on the visible and invisible church, church government, the papacy, councils, the discipline of the church, the sacraments (baptism and the Lord's Supper), and civil government.
